description:
About our brand and products

Femi.Eko® is a European menstrual care brand created to offer women safer, more comfortable, and more responsible solutions for their period.

Our range covers real menstrual needs, from reusable products to single-use options made from 100% certified organic cotton, as well as innovative solutions designed to reduce environmental impact without compromising intimate health.

All Femi.Eko® products are dermatologically and gynecologically tested, free from harsh chemicals, perfumes, and unnecessary plastic. Menstruation is normal, and period care should be too.

What makes us different

We stand out through real innovation, safety, and responsibility.

– One of the most diverse sustainable menstrual care ranges in Europe
– Reusable products and organic disposable options, free from chemicals and plastic
– Registered innovations and patented technologies
– The only brand in Romania offering menstrual dispensers
– Products designed for different bodies, life stages, and real-life needs
– Strong focus on education, transparency, and women’s health
– A brand built around care, not stigma or pressure

How affiliates can earn

As a Femi.Eko® affiliate, you earn by sharing products you genuinely trust.

– Personal discount code or unique tracking link
– Monthly cashback commissions:
– 15% commission on codes offering 15% discount
– 10% commission on codes offering 20% discount
– Performance tracking available at all times through UpPromote
– Seasonal gifts, exclusive launches, and brand visibility opportunities

Your audience benefits from clear discounts, and you earn based on real impact.

How to promote us

We encourage authentic, honest content created in your own style.

You can promote Femi.Eko® through:
– Instagram posts, Reels, Stories
– TikTok videos
– YouTube reviews or vlogs
– Blog articles or Q&A formats

We ask affiliates to:
– Share real experiences and honest opinions
– Use correct product names and brand tags
– Clearly disclose the partnership (#ad / #affiliate)
– Keep a respectful, educational tone
– Focus on comfort, safety, and real-life use

No scripts. No pressure. Authenticity matters more than audience size.

Other information

– No minimum follower requirement
– Open to creators, mothers, health professionals, and educators
– Full access to product and educational resources
– Direct communication with the Femi.Eko® team
– Part of a community focused on women’s health, sustainability, and care

By joining Femi.Eko®, you’re not just promoting products.
You’re supporting better period care, informed choices, and real impact for women and the planet.
